market_definition: The single-sided adhesive tapes market comprises tapes with adhesive on one face of a backing for sealing, protecting, wrapping and fastening. It measures sales of finished packaging, cloth, duct, filament and other general-purpose single-sided tapes, excluding masking and electrical grades. BY BACKING MATERIAL: BOPP / Polypropylene, PVC, Cloth / Fabric, Paper, PET & Other Films. BY ADHESIVE CHEMISTRY: Acrylic, Rubber, Hot Melt, Silicone. BY PRODUCT FUNCTION: Sealing, Duct / Repair, Strapping / Filament, Other Functions. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive & Transportation, Building & Construction, Electronics & Electrical, Packaging & Logistics, Medical & Hygiene, Paints, Coatings & Surface Finishing, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Masking tapes; electrical insulation tapes; double-sided and transfer tapes; thermally conductive tapes. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor.
